summary: Innovative Industrial Properties filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an offering of 2,000,000 shares of 9.25% Series B Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock at a $25.00 liquidation preference, equal to a fixed annual rate of $2.3125 per share. Dividends are payable quarterly beginning January 15, 2027. The issue ranks pari passu with the 9.00% Series A preferred and senior to common. Redemption is generally prohibited before October 19, 2031, with a change-of-control conversion right. Listing on the NYSE under IIPR Pr B is planned; this is a routine preferred shelf takedown.
